paragraphs: Kayem Foods Inc. is recalling more than 1.5 million pounds of ready-to-eat meat and poultry products, including hot dogs, bacon, sausage, and turkey breasts, due to possible temperature abuse during storage [1][14]. Consumers should not eat these products and should discard them or return them to the store [14].

Lidl US is recalling Gelatelli Coffee & Vanilla Gelato with Coffee Sauce & Cookie Pieces (16 FL OZ, UPC 4 0564897 22458, Lot 085261, Best By MAR/26/2028) because it may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes [2][11]. The product was distributed to all Lidl US retail locations between July 19 and October 15, 2026 [11].

Family Farmstead Dairy is recalling raw mild cheddar cheese that may be contaminated with E. coli O157:H7 bacteria, which causes diarrheal illness often with bloody stools [3][19]. The affected cheese was distributed to grocers in New York and New Jersey [19]. Pan Pepin Inc. is also recalling certain lots of Para Bien Al Grano due to undeclared sesame, an allergen [5].
